source_reference.key_evidence: Large normative dataset with diffusion and resting-state fMRI for healthy young adults.
source_reference.use_in_project: Source for structural-connectome graph and null sensitivity.
source_reference.claim_boundary: Proxy graph controls are not structural-connectome evidence; an HCP/normative module graph is required for the stronger E claim.

claim_guardrail: HCP structural-control claims require a documented structural-connectome graph, not the macro-module proxy graph.

network_control_energy.method: finite-horizon discrete network-control energy over matched PCA-state centroids; control profiles share the same mean control budget
network_control_energy.equation: x[t+1] = A_graph x[t] + B_profile u[t]; energy = min sum_t ||u[t]||^2 over a finite horizon
network_control_energy.receptor_prior_source: coarse module-level proxy prior from receptor-gradient model config; not a PET-derived receptor map
